digest.component_or_area: LLM configuration and model class resolver
propositions: rebar requires a schema to express which model is used for which capability tier (frontier, standard, trivial) rather than relying on a single scalar cfg.model
the config schema must support per-tier slots with model, provider, endpoint, and optional fallback array; secrets (api_key) are forbidden in both slots and fallback entries
env-var overrides are per-field and preserve existing precedence (CLI > env > config file > default) without inventing object-merge semantics
the fallback array is non-recursive; entries cannot themselves carry a fallback key, and such nesting is a typed config error
a new load_class_slots entry point in model_classes.py must extract the model_classes sub-table from real configuration and return resolved class slots, making the schema reachable from actual config
default values must preserve byte-identical behavior to the current release when nothing is configured (frontier: claude-opus-4-8, standard: claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial: claude-haiku-4-5)
